question.text: Will the Section 122 measure affecting Canada expire on schedule by 2026-09-15?

documents.title: Section 122 balance-of-payments tariff set with 150-day statutory limit
documents.text: A Section 122 tariff measure is imposed with a statutory 150-day expiry unless Congress acts to extend it.

documents.title: Congress shows no appetite to extend Section 122 measure
documents.text: Hill sources indicate the Section 122 tariff extension lacks votes; the measure is likely to expire on schedule.

documents.title: Administration signals it will let Section 122 lapse
documents.text: Officials say the Section 122 measure will be allowed to lapse at its statutory deadline, a de-escalation.

documents.title: Federal Register: Section 122 measure expired
documents.text: The Section 122 tariff measure affecting Canada expired on schedule without extension.
